units.source_text: 源氏公子不能安然就寝。

en.t: Prince Genji could not settle down to sleep peacefully.

units.source_text: 他觉得独眠很是无聊。

en.t: He found sleeping alone terribly dull.

units.source_text: 张目四顾，想道：“这靠北的纸隔扇那边有女人住着。

en.t: He opened his eyes and looked around, thinking, "A woman is staying beyond that paper partition on the north side.

units.source_text: 刚才说起的那个女子大概就躲在这里面吧。

en.t: The woman they were just talking about is probably hidden in there.

units.source_text: 可怜的人儿啊！”

en.t: Poor thing!"

units.source_text: 他心驰神往，便从容地站起身来，走到纸隔扇旁边，倾耳偷听，

en.t: His thoughts carried away, he calmly rose, went over to the paper partition, and bent his ear to listen in.

units.source_text: 但闻刚才看到的那个小君的声音说：“喂，你在哪里？”

en.t: Then he heard the voice of the young boy he had seen earlier say, "Hey, where are you?"

units.source_text: 带些沙音，却很悦耳。

en.t: It was a little husky, but very pleasant to hear.

units.source_text: 接着一个女声回答道：“我睡在这里呢。

en.t: Then a woman's voice answered, "I am sleeping here.

units.source_text: 客人睡了吧？

en.t: Has the guest gone to sleep?

units.source_text: 我怕相隔太近，不好意思，其实隔得还算远。”

en.t: I was embarrassed, afraid we were too close, but actually we are still fairly far apart."

units.source_text: 是躺在床里说的，语调随意不拘。

en.t: She spoke while lying in bed, her tone casual and unguarded.

units.source_text: 但很像那孩子的声音，听得出这两人是姐弟。

en.t: But her voice sounded very much like the boy's, and it was clear the two were sister and brother.

units.source_text: 又听得那孩子悄悄地说道：“客人睡在厢房里呢。

en.t: Then he heard the boy whisper, "The guest is sleeping in the side room.

units.source_text: 我听说源氏公子很漂亮，今天初次看到，果然是个美男子。”

en.t: I had heard that Prince Genji was beautiful, and when I saw him for the first time today, he really was a handsome man."

units.source_text: 他姐姐说：“倘是白天，我也来偷看一下。”

en.t: His sister said, "If it were daytime, I would go sneak a look too."

units.source_text: 声音带着睡意，是躺在被窝里说的。

en.t: Her voice was drowsy, and she was speaking from under the covers.

units.source_text: 源氏公子嫌她态度冷淡，没有向她弟弟详细探问他的情状，心中略感不快。

en.t: Prince Genji was slightly displeased, feeling that her attitude was cold and that she had not questioned her brother closely about him.

units.source_text: 接着弟弟又说：“我睡在这边吧。

en.t: Then the younger brother said again, "I suppose I will sleep over here.

units.source_text: 唉，暗得很。”

en.t: Ah, it is terribly dark."

units.source_text: 听见他挑灯的声音。

en.t: Genji heard the sound of him raising the lamp flame.

units.source_text: 那女子睡的地方，似乎是这纸隔扇的斜对面。

en.t: The place where the woman was sleeping seemed to be diagonally across from this paper partition.

units.source_text: 她说：“中将[\[28\]](#part1331.html#m28)哪里去了？

en.t: She said, "Where has Chujo[\[28\]](#part1331.html#m28) gone?

units.source_text: 我这里离开人远，有些害怕呢。”

en.t: I am far away from everyone here, and it is a little frightening."

units.source_text: 睡在门外的侍女们回答道：“她到后面去洗澡了，立刻就回来的。”

en.t: The maids sleeping outside the door answered, "She has gone to the back to bathe and will be back at once."
